title: No heat tonight? Check these

scenes.say: The heat just quit on a cold night.
scenes.visual: frost on a window at night with a dark living room behind it

scenes.say: Check that the thermostat is set to heat.
scenes.visual: a hand adjusting a wall thermostat in a hallway, close up

scenes.say: Make sure its batteries are not dead.
scenes.visual: hands holding two AA batteries next to an open thermostat

scenes.say: Then check the breaker and the service switch.
scenes.visual: a hand opening a gray electrical breaker panel in a basement

scenes.say: If you smell gas, leave and call the gas utility or 911 first.
scenes.visual: a front door standing open to a cold night, porch light on, nobody inside

scenes.say: Still no heat? Tell us the system type and what it is doing.
scenes.visual: an older furnace in a basement with a flashlight beam on it
a clean white plumbing service van parked on a quiet small-town street at dusk, warm lights in the houses

caption: No heat? Two quick checks before you call. No-heat calls are answered day or night.
